summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py with SHACLPathError and parse_shacl_path(shapes_graph, path_identifier), and test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py with a parametrized test over valid and invalid shapes. No existing files changed and nothing was committed. Tests: test_shacl_extras.py, test/test_path.py, and test/test_extras all pass (test_extras: 98 passed, 2 skipped, 3 xfailed). Non-node inputs (None, plain string) raise SHACLPathError, a Literal raises TypeError, and the graph is unchanged after calls. mypy, ruff, and black are not in the prepared venv, so the type-check and lint gates were applied by reading the code only. Open point: the "expected-exception context" line in the test has no type-ignore comment, because the checker accepts it; the spec's wording could be read to require one.
